function.name: overlapping
function.description: This function checks if two rectangles overlap each other

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first rectangle

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second rectangle

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the rectangles overlap and FALSE otherwise

function.name: grow_region
function.description: This function grows the size of a given region. If the size is less than or equal to the current size of the region, it returns true. If the region's rectangles are equal to the region's rectangle buffer, it allocates new memory for the rectangles. If not, it reallocates the memory. If memory allocation or reallocation fails, it returns false. Otherwise, it updates the region's rectangles and size, and returns true.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be grown

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The new size for the region

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the region was successfully grown or not

function.name: add_rect
function.description: This function adds a rectangle to the given region. If the region is full, it attempts to grow the region. The rectangle is defined by its left, top, right, and bottom coordinates.

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where the rectangle will be added

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The left coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The right coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate of the rectangle

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the rectangle was successfully added to the region, FALSE otherwise

function.name: empty_region
function.description: This function resets the properties of a WINEREGION object to their initial state.

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: A pointer to the WINEREGION object to be reset.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: is_in_rect
function.description: This function checks if a point (x, y) is within a given rectangle.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the x-coordinate of the point.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the y-coordinate of the point.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the point is within the rectangle, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: bres_init_polygon
function.description: This function initializes the Bresenham's line algorithm for polygon rendering. It calculates the slope and increments for the algorithm based on the input parameters.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The difference in y-coordinates of two points on the polygon edge.

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the first point on the polygon edge.

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the second point on the polygon edge.

parameters.name: bres
parameters.description: A pointer to a bres_info structure where the calculated values for the Bresenham's line algorithm will be stored.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the bres_info structure pointed by the 'bres' parameter.

function.name: bres_incr_polygon
function.description: This function increments the values of minor_axis and d in the bres_info structure based on the conditions of m1 and d.

parameters.name: bres
parameters.description: Pointer to a bres_info structure which contains the variables to be incremented.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: get_region_type
function.description: This function determines the type of a given wine region based on the number of rectangles it contains.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to the wine region object to be evaluated.

function.return_type: INT, represents the type of the region. It can be NULLREGION if the region contains no rectangles, SIMPLEREGION if it contains one rectangle, or COMPLEXREGION if it contains more than one rectangle.

function.name: REGION_DumpRegion
function.description: This function dumps the details of a given region, including its extents and rectangles, to the trace log.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: A pointer to the region to be dumped.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return anything

function.name: init_region
function.description: This function initializes a region with a given size. If the size is larger than the default, it allocates memory for the region. Otherwise, it uses the buffer already present in the region. It then empties the region and returns a boolean value indicating the success of the operation.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be initialized

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: The size of the region to be initialized

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the region is successfully initialized, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: destroy_region
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the rects field of the WINEREGION structure if it is not the same as the rects_buf field.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to a WINEREGION structure

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: free_region
function.description: This function destroys the region and frees the memory allocated to the region.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the region to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: alloc_region
function.description: This function allocates memory for a WINEREGION object and initializes it. If the initialization fails, it frees the allocated memory and sets the pointer to NULL.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: This parameter is used for initializing the WINEREGION object

function.return_type: WINEREGION pointer, represents a pointer to the allocated and initialized WINEREGION object, or NULL if the initialization failed

function.name: move_rects
function.description: This function moves rectangles from a source region to a destination region, destroying the destination region first. If the source rectangles are in the buffer, they are copied to the destination buffer. Otherwise, the destination rectangles pointer is set to the source rectangles. The size and number of rectangles are also copied from the source to the destination. Finally, the source region is initialized with zero rectangles.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination region where the rectangles will be moved to.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source region where the rectangles will be moved from.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: REGION_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a region object by freeing the GDI handle and the region itself.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the GDI object that is to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the object was successfully deleted and FALSE indicates that the object could not be deleted.

function.name: REGION_OffsetRegion
function.description: This function offsets a region by a given x and y value. If the source region is not the same as the destination region, it first copies the source region to the destination. Then, if either x or y is non-zero, it offsets all rectangles in the region and the extents of the region by these values.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination region

parameters.name: srcrgn
parameters.description: Pointer to the source region

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x offset

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y offset

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: NtGdiOffsetRgn
function.description: This function offsets a region by the specified amount in the x and y directions.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: This is a handle to the region to be offset.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the amount by which the region is to be offset in the x direction.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the amount by which the region is to be offset in the y direction.

function.return_type: INT, represents the type of the region after it has been offset. If the region handle is invalid, it returns ERROR.

function.name: NtGdiGetRgnBox
function.description: This function retrieves the bounding box of a region and returns the type of the region.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the region.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a RECT structure that will receive the bounding box of the region.

function.return_type: INT, represents the type of the region if the function succeeds, or an error code if the function fails.

function.name: NtGdiCreateRectRgn
function.description: This function creates a rectangular region and returns a handle to it.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

function.return_type: HRGN, which represents a handle to the newly created rectangular region. Returns 0 if the region creation fails.

function.name: NtGdiSetRectRgn
function.description: This function sets the dimensions of a rectangular region. It swaps the values of left and right, and top and bottom if left > right or top > bottom. If left != right and top != bottom, it sets the dimensions of the region and the number of rectangles to 1. If not, it empties the region. It then releases the region object and returns TRUE.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully sets the dimensions of the region, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiCreateRoundRectRgn
function.description: This function creates a rounded rectangle region. The region is defined by the corners specified by the left, top, right, and bottom parameters, and the ellipse used to create the corners of the rounded rectangle is specified by the ellipse_width and ellipse_height parameters.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: ellipse_width
parameters.description: The width of the ellipse used to create the rounded corners of the rectangle

parameters.name: ellipse_height
parameters.description: The height of the ellipse used to create the rounded corners of the rectangle

function.return_type: HRGN, represents the handle to the region if the function succeeds, or zero otherwise

function.name: NtGdiCreateEllipticRgn
function.description: This function creates an elliptical region using the specified coordinates.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

function.return_type: HRGN, represents the handle to the region if the function is successful. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiGetRegionData
function.description: This function retrieves the data for a specified region. It checks if the region object exists, calculates the size of the region data, checks if the buffer is large enough to hold the data, and if so, copies the data into the buffer. If the buffer is too small or null, it returns the required buffer size.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The size of the buffer for the region data.

parameters.name: rgndata
parameters.description: Pointer to a RGNDATA structure that will receive the region data.

function.return_type: DWORD. If the function succeeds, the return value is the number of bytes stored in the buffer. If the buffer is too small or null, the return value is the required buffer size. If the region does not exist, the return value is zero.

function.name: translate
function.description: This function translates a set of points according to a given transformation matrix.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to the first element of an array of points to be translated.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of points in the array that will be translated.

parameters.name: xform
parameters.description: Pointer to the transformation matrix used for translation.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the input points in place.

function.name: NtGdiExtCreateRegion
function.description: This function creates a region using the specified transformation, count, and region data. It also checks for valid input and handles errors accordingly.

parameters.name: xform
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the transformation to be applied to the region.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This is the count of the number of rectangles in the region data.

parameters.name: rgndata
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the region data which contains information about the region to be created.

function.return_type: HRGN, which represents the handle to the created region. If the region creation fails, the function returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiPtInRegion
function.description: This function checks if a given point is in a specific region.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: This is a handle to the region.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the x-coordinate of the point.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the y-coordinate of the point.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the point is in the region, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiRectInRegion
function.description: This function checks if a given rectangle overlaps with any rectangle in a specified region. It normalizes the input rectangle, retrieves the region object, and iterates through its rectangles to find an overlap.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: This is a handle to the region where the function checks for overlaps.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle that the function checks for overlaps within the region.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the rectangle overlaps with at least one rectangle in the region, and FALSE indicates no overlap.

function.name: NtGdiEqualRgn
function.description: This function checks if two regions (hrgn1 and hrgn2) are equal. It compares the number of rectangles in each region, the extents of the regions, and the properties of each rectangle in the regions.

parameters.name: hrgn1
parameters.description: The first region to be compared.

parameters.name: hrgn2
parameters.description: The second region to be compared.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the regions are equal, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: REGION_UnionRectWithRegion
function.description: This function unites a rectangle with a region.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle to be united with the region.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the region with which the rectangle will be united.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the union of the rectangle and the region was successful or not.

function.name: add_rect_to_region
function.description: This function adds a rectangle to a region. It first retrieves the region object, checks if it exists, and then unites the rectangle with the region. Finally, it releases the region object and returns the result of the union operation.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: This is the handle to the region where the rectangle will be added.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle that will be added to the region.

function.return_type: BOOL. This function returns TRUE if the rectangle was successfully added to the region, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: REGION_FrameRgn
function.description: This function frames a region by offsetting, intersecting and subtracting regions. It releases the GDI objects after use.

parameters.name: hDest
parameters.description: Handle to the destination region

parameters.name: hSrc
parameters.description: Handle to the source region

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Horizontal offset

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Vertical offset

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not

function.name: NtGdiCombineRgn
function.description: This function combines two source regions (hSrc1 and hSrc2) into a destination region (hDest) based on the specified mode. The mode can be RGN_AND, RGN_OR, RGN_XOR, RGN_DIFF, or RGN_COPY. The function also traces and dumps the region objects for debugging purposes.

parameters.name: hDest
parameters.description: Handle to the destination region where the result of the operation will be stored

parameters.name: hSrc1
parameters.description: Handle to the first source region to be combined

parameters.name: hSrc2
parameters.description: Handle to the second source region to be combined

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode of the operation. It can be RGN_AND, RGN_OR, RGN_XOR, RGN_DIFF, or RGN_COPY

function.return_type: INT, represents the type of the region after the operation. If an error occurs, the function returns ERROR

function.name: REGION_SetExtents
function.description: This function sets the extents of a region. If the region has no rectangles, it sets all extents to 0. Otherwise, it sets the extents to the smallest and largest values found in the rectangles of the region.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: A pointer to the region whose extents are to be set.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: REGION_CopyRegion
function.description: This function copies the content of one WINEREGION structure to another. If the destination region is smaller than the source, it attempts to grow the destination region. If it can't, it returns FALSE. Otherwise, it copies the data and returns TRUE.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination region where the content of the source region will be copied.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source region whose content will be copied to the destination region.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the copy operation is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: REGION_MirrorRegion
function.description: This function mirrors a region horizontally based on a specified width. It modifies the destination region to be the mirrored version of the source region.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination region. This region is modified to be the mirrored version of the source region.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source region. This region is mirrored horizontally.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width used for mirroring the region. The mirroring is done based on this width.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: mirror_region
function.description: This function mirrors a source region into a destination region with a specified width.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination region where the source region will be mirrored.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source region which will be mirrored into the destination region.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: This is the width of the mirror region.

function.return_type: INT, represents the type of the region if the mirroring is successful, otherwise it returns an error.

function.name: mirror_window_region
function.description: This function mirrors a specified region of a window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be mirrored.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region in the window to be mirrored.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully mirrors the region, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: REGION_Coalesce
function.description: This function coalesces or merges bands of rectangles in a region if they are in the same position and have the same dimensions. It also adjusts the bottom of each rectangle in the previous band to that of the corresponding rectangle in the current band.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region to be coalesced

parameters.name: prevStart
parameters.description: Index of the start of the previous band of rectangles

parameters.name: curStart
parameters.description: Index of the start of the current band of rectangles

function.return_type: INT, represents the index of the start of the current or previous band depending on whether coalescing was possible or not

function.name: REGION_compact
function.description: This function compacts the size of the region if the number of rectangles is less than half the size of the region and greater than the default rectangles. It reallocates memory for the rectangles and updates the size of the region.

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region that needs to be compacted

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: REGION_RegionOp
function.description: This function performs an operation on two regions, using the provided overlap and non-overlap functions, and stores the result in a destination region.

parameters.name: destReg
parameters.description: Place to store the result of the operation

parameters.name: reg1
parameters.description: First region in the operation

parameters.name: reg2
parameters.description: Second region in the operation

parameters.name: overlapFunc
parameters.type: BOOL (*)(WINEREGION*, RECT*, RECT*, RECT*, RECT*, INT, INT)
parameters.description: Function to call for overlapping bands

parameters.name: nonOverlap1Func
parameters.description: Function to call for non-overlapping bands in the first region

parameters.name: nonOverlap2Func
parameters.description: Function to call for non-overlapping bands in the second region

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation was successful, FALSE otherwise

function.name: REGION_IntersectO
function.description: This function checks for any overlap between two rectangles and adds that overlap to a new region. It advances the pointers based on which rectangle extends to the right the least.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the new region where overlaps are added

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: Pointer to the start of the first rectangle

parameters.name: r1End
parameters.description: Pointer to the end of the first rectangle

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: Pointer to the start of the second rectangle

parameters.name: r2End
parameters.description: Pointer to the end of the second rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Top boundary of the overlap region

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Bottom boundary of the overlap region

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function executes successfully, and FALSE if the function fails to add the overlap to the new region

function.name: REGION_IntersectRegion
function.description: This function checks for intersection between two regions and updates the new region based on the intersection. If no intersection is found, the new region is set to have no rectangles. The function also sets the extents of the new region.

parameters.name: newReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the new region that will be updated based on the intersection of reg1 and reg2

parameters.name: reg1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first region to check for intersection

parameters.name: reg2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second region to check for intersection

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise

function.name: REGION_UnionNonO
function.description: This function iterates through a range of rectangles, adding each to a region until the end of the range is reached or an error occurs.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where rectangles will be added

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Pointer to the start of the range of rectangles to be added

parameters.name: rEnd
parameters.description: Pointer to the end of the range of rectangles to be added

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate of the rectangles to be added

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate of the rectangles to be added

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if all rectangles were successfully added, FALSE if an error occurred

function.name: REGION_UnionO
function.description: This function merges two regions based on the provided parameters. It uses a macro named MERGERECT to perform the merging operation. The function iterates over the rectangles in the two regions, and merges them if certain conditions are met. If the merging operation is successful, the function returns TRUE, otherwise it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where the result of the union operation will be stored.

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first rectangle of the first region to be merged.

parameters.name: r1End
parameters.description: Pointer to the last rectangle of the first region to be merged.

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: Pointer to the first rectangle of the second region to be merged.

parameters.name: r2End
parameters.description: Pointer to the last rectangle of the second region to be merged.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate of the rectangle to be merged.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate of the rectangle to be merged.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the merging operation was successful or not. Returns TRUE if successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: REGION_UnionRegion
function.description: This function unites two regions and stores the result in a new region. It handles various cases such as when the regions are the same, one is empty, or one completely subsumes the other.

parameters.name: newReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the new region where the result of the union operation will be stored

parameters.name: reg1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first region to be united

parameters.name: reg2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second region to be united

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the union operation was successful or not

function.name: REGION_SubtractNonO1
function.description: This function iterates over a range of rectangles from 'r' to 'rEnd', and for each rectangle, it attempts to add a new rectangle to the 'pReg' region with the specified 'top' and 'bottom'. If the addition of any rectangle fails, it immediately returns FALSE. If all rectangles are added successfully, it returns TRUE.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where new rectangles are to be added

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Pointer to the start of the range of rectangles to be processed

parameters.name: rEnd
parameters.description: Pointer to the end of the range of rectangles to be processed

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate for the new rectangles to be added to the region

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate for the new rectangles to be added to the region

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if all rectangles are added successfully, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: REGION_SubtractO
function.description: This function subtracts one region from another. It iterates over the rectangles in the minuend and subtrahend regions, and adds the uncovered parts of the minuend to the new region.

parameters.name: pReg
parameters.description: Pointer to the region where the result will be stored

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first rectangle in the minuend region

parameters.name: r1End
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle after the last one in the minuend region

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: Pointer to the first rectangle in the subtrahend region

parameters.name: r2End
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle after the last one in the subtrahend region

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate of the rectangles to be added to the region

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate of the rectangles to be added to the region

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation was successful, FALSE otherwise

function.name: REGION_SubtractRegion
function.description: This function subtracts one region from another. If the regions do not overlap, it simply copies the first region. If they do overlap, it performs a region operation to subtract the second region from the first. It then sets the extents of the resulting region.

parameters.name: regD
parameters.description: This is the destination region where the result of the subtraction will be stored.

parameters.name: regM
parameters.description: This is the minuend region from which another region will be subtracted.

parameters.name: regS
parameters.description: This is the subtrahend region which will be subtracted from the minuend region.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the operation was successful, and FALSE indicates that the operation failed.

function.name: REGION_XorRegion
function.description: This function performs the XOR operation on two regions and stores the result in a third region. It first initializes two temporary regions, then subtracts each source region from the other, and finally unites the two results into the destination region. The temporary regions are destroyed before the function returns.

parameters.name: dr
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination region where the result of the XOR operation will be stored

parameters.name: sra
parameters.description: Pointer to the first source region for the XOR operation

parameters.name: srb
parameters.description: Pointer to the second source region for the XOR operation

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not

function.name: REGION_InsertEdgeInET
function.description: This function inserts an edge into the Edge Table (ET). It finds the right bucket to put the edge into, reassigns the pointer to ScanLineList if necessary, and then inserts the edge in the right bucket.

parameters.name: ET
parameters.description: Pointer to the Edge Table

parameters.name: ETE
parameters.description: Pointer to the Edge Table Entry

parameters.name: scanline
parameters.description: The scanline where the edge is to be inserted

parameters.name: SLLBlock
parameters.description: Pointer to the Scan Line List Block

parameters.name: iSLLBlock
parameters.description: Pointer to the index of the Scan Line List Block

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: REGION_CreateEdgeTable
function.description: This function initializes an edge table for a polygon region, calculates the y min and y max for the edge table, and inserts edges into the edge table. It also handles the case of overflow.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Pointer to the count of vertices in each polygon

parameters.name: nbpolygons
parameters.description: Number of polygons

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of points representing vertices of polygons

parameters.name: ET
parameters.description: Pointer to the Edge Table to be initialized and filled

parameters.name: pETEs
parameters.description: Pointer to the Edge Table Entries to be filled

parameters.name: pSLLBlock
parameters.description: Pointer to the Scan Line List Block

parameters.name: clip_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the clipping rectangle. If present, only the part of the polygon that lies within this rectangle is processed

function.return_type: unsigned int representing the total change in y across all edges of the polygon. Returns 0 in case of overflow

function.name: REGION_loadAET
function.description: This function loads an Active Edge Table (AET) with Edge Table Entries (ETEs). It iterates through each ETE, finds its appropriate position in the AET based on the minor axis, and inserts it there.

parameters.name: AET
parameters.description: Pointer to the Active Edge Table to be loaded

parameters.name: ETEs
parameters.description: Pointer to the Edge Table Entries to be loaded into the AET

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the AET in place

function.name: REGION_computeWAET
function.description: This function initializes the WETE list, iterates over the AET list, and based on certain conditions, adds the winding_entry of the active element to the WETE list and toggles the inside flag.

parameters.name: AET
parameters.description: Pointer to the Active Edge Table list

parameters.name: WETE
parameters.description: Pointer to the Winding-Even Table Entry list

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: next_scanline
function.description: This function iterates over the Active Edge Table (AET), removes the edges that are no longer relevant, increments the Bresenham values for the remaining edges, and reorders the AET based on the new Bresenham values.

parameters.name: AET
parameters.description: Pointer to the Active Edge Table (AET)

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the current scanline

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the AET was modified, FALSE otherwise

function.name: REGION_FreeStorage
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to a linked list of ScanLineListBlock objects.

parameters.name: pSLLBlock
parameters.description: Pointer to the first block in a linked list of ScanLineListBlock objects.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: scan_convert
function.description: This function performs scan conversion, which is a process of converting 2D or 3D objects in a scene into a 2D image. It handles two modes of operation, WINDING and non-WINDING, and manages active edge tables and scanlines for the conversion process.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the WINEREGION object that the function will modify.

parameters.name: ET
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the EdgeTable object that the function will use for the scan conversion.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: This parameter determines the mode of operation. It can be WINDING or non-WINDING.

parameters.name: clip_rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the RECT object that defines the clipping rectangle. If this parameter is not NULL, the function will clip the output to this rectangle.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the WINEREGION object passed as a parameter.

function.name: create_polypolygon_region
function.description: This function creates a polygonal region from a set of points, with special handling for rectangular regions. It also handles memory allocation and deallocation for the region.

parameters.name: Pts
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of points defining the vertices of the polygons

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of integers specifying the number of points in each polygon

parameters.name: nbpolygons
parameters.description: Number of polygons

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode for the scan conversion of the polygons

parameters.name: clip_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the clipping rectangle

function.return_type: HRGN, represents the handle to the resulting region
